owner_notes: The block measurements for FTG's towns are finished. All 28 planned towns are saved and measured, plus the two older test cities, and all six checks pass, including the one that required waiting for the last town. The row-building step (W-15) can now use these numbers.

What the full set shows: FTG's city blocks are about 2 300-2 400 square metres at the median whatever the town's size, and at most about 86-89 % of the land inside the districts can be plots. Our design's 0.62 dense-core figure sits comfortably inside that range, so nothing needs changing.

One new side finding. On the last town (the coastal town that FTG's own list calls a big town), two towers stand at the water's edge away from the wall, one on the sea side and one on the river side. Every other tower on every town sits on a wall corner or bend. It is a description of FTG, and no change to our design is asked.
